addictionPotential: 生理成瘾中等至高，心理成瘾中等。
toxicities: 在负责任或医疗使用下被认为安全且无毒。
剂量超过 10 克与死亡风险相关。
summary: 一种产生欣快的抑制剂，作为助眠药并有时用于酒精戒断。也用于娱乐性抑制剂，作为较低毒性的酒精替代品。尽管毒性不如酒精，但因市售溶液浓度不一致等原因仍有风险，与其他抑制剂合用可能非常危险。
effectsSummary: Euphoria, sociability, disinhibition, sedation, drowsiness, increased libido. Overdose can cause unconsciousness and respiratory depression.
generalRisks: Very narrow safety margin. Overdose causes vomiting, unconsciousness, respiratory depression. Mixing with alcohol or other depressants is extremely dangerous.
longtermRisks: Dependence develops quickly with frequent use. Withdrawal can be severe and includes anxiety, insomnia, and psychosis.
saferUse: Measure doses accurately with a syringe - never estimate.
Do not mix with alcohol or other depressants.
Never redose within 3-4 hours of initial dose.

tolerance.full: [TBT] within several days of continuous use
